Billionaire soccer legend Cristiano Ronaldo announced Thursday he will retire from Portugal’s national team, ending a record-breaking career that spanned two decades and made him one of the world’s wealthiest athletes, just a month after longtime rival Lionel Messi played his final game for Argentina.

author: Forbes
description:
Elon Musk’s pinned tweet—at least until Tuesday night—sums up his thoughts succinctly: If Democrats won the midterms, and then the presidency in 2028, it would be “the end of democracy in any meaningful sense of the word.” In his telling, Democrats would abolish the filibuster, pack the Supreme Court, expand the Senate and institute open borders, all policies that he claims would lock Republicans out of power forever.

In the waning days of the campaign, the richest man in the world put his money where his mouth was, flooding races across the country with at least $458 million, according to Federal Election Commission filings and other reporting. That’s far more than any other donor—at least three times as much as the billionaire Uihlein couple in second place, per New York Times estimates. It’s also close to three times what George Soros, the man Musk has spent years casting as the hidden hand behind the Democratic Party, disclosed spending in his biggest election ever.

title: Elon’s ROI: $458 Million Didn’t Buy Much In The Midterms

author: Forbes
description:
Ecovative and My Forest Foods co-founder Eben Bayer reveals how he bypassed traditional food science timelines by using ChatGPT to formulate a new plant-based mycelium steak for Whole Foods. Facing extreme time pressure, Bayer collaborated directly with the AI—acting as its "mouth" to provide sensory feedback while the AI processed complex diffusion dynamics and flavor overlaps.
